geocode_note: Fixes come from gen_trx_sua.geocode_items after rewriting each 'NAV <Rbbb> <Dddd>' token triple into a single FRD point (rdp). The owner's LM-token path would also keep NAV as a waypoint, sending the route over NAV and then back to the FRD point; filed-route (FP_ROUTE) semantics emit only the FRD point. As in the owner's FP_ROUTE path, geocode_items resolves the plain fixes first and each FRD's parent navaid afterwards, so a parent is disambiguated after the plain fixes rather than in route order. Tokens are unchanged; only the geocoding differs.
